title.zh: 将苏禄省因达南市镇塔格巴克小学的名称变更为Panglima Mammah小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Tagbak Elementary School in the Municipality of Indanan, Province of Sulu, to Panglima Mammah Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Tagbak Elementary School in the Municipality of Indanan, Province of Sulu, to Panglima Mammah Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Tagbak tại Thị trấn Indanan, Tỉnh Sulu thành Trường tiểu học Panglima Mammah
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Tagbak ในเทศบาล Indanan, จังหวัด Sulu เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Panglima Mammah
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Tagbak di Kotamadya Indanan, Provinsi Sulu menjadi Sekolah Dasar Panglima Mammah
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Tagbak di Perbandaran Indanan, Wilayah Sulu menjadi Sekolah Rendah Panglima Mammah

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_4019_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Tagbak Elementary School in the Municipality of Indanan, Province of Sulu, is changed to Panglima Mammah Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1964.
